tooltip: Special Effects – Applies a special visual effect to the camera output
content1: Applies a special visual effect to the camera output: Normal, Black And White, GrayScale, Negative, or Sketch.
content2:
GET_SPECIAL_EFFECTS_CU84 (0x03), SET_SPECIAL_EFFECTS_CU84 (0x04).
SpecialEffectCU84 Enum indicates the effect to be applied:
  1. NORMAL (0x01) – No effect applied.
  2. BLACK_WHITE (0x04) – Black and white effect.
  3. GREYSCALE (0x07) – Greyscale effect.
  4. NEGATIVE (0x08) – Negative effect.
  5. SKETCH (0x10) – Sketch effect.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current special effect mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the special effect mode of the camera.

tooltip: Denoise Strength – Adjusts the noise reduction strength applied to the image
content1: Adjusts the level of noise reduction applied to the camera image. Higher values result in stronger noise reduction. The value ranges from 0 to 15.
content2:
GET_DENOISE_VALUE_CU84 (0x05), SET_DENOISE_VALUE_CU84 (0x06).
The denoise strength is passed directly as a uint8_t value (range: 0–15).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current denoise strength value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the denoise strength of the camera (range: 0–15).

tooltip: Image Capture – Sets the still capture burst length
content1: Selects the number of frames (1 through 5) captured in a single still-capture burst.
content2:
GET_BURST_LENGTH_CU84 (0x19), SET_BURST_LENGTH_CU84 (0x1A).
The burst length is passed directly as a uint8_t value (1–5 in the UI).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current burst length of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the number of frames captured in a burst.

tooltip: Flip Control – Controls horizontal and vertical image flipping
content1: Controls the horizontal (mirror) and/or vertical flipping of the camera image output. Both flips can be enabled or disabled independently.
content2:
GET_FLIP_MODE_CU84 (0x0B), SET_FLIP_MODE_CU84 (0x0C).
FlipModeCU84 Enum specifies the flip configuration:
  1. NORMAL (0x00): No flipping applied.
  2. HORIZONTAL (0x01): Only horizontal flip is applied.
  3. VERTICAL (0x02): Only vertical flip is applied.
  4. BOTH (0x03): Both horizontal and vertical flips are applied.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flip mode (FlipModeCU84 value) of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the horizontal and vertical flip independently; the SDK maps the two flags to the corresponding FlipModeCU84 value.

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Configures the Region of Interest for auto-exposure
content1: Configures the Region of Interest (ROI) used by auto-exposure. Full uses the whole frame; Manual uses a window around a selected point, with the window size chosen from the Value list (1–8).
content2:
GET_AUTO_EXP_ROI_MODE_CU84 (0x07), SET_AUTO_EXP_ROI_MODE_CU84 (0x08).
1. ROIAutoExpModeCU84 Enum specifies the ROI auto-exposure mode:
   - FULL_ROI (0x01): Expose based on the full frame.
   - MANUAL_ROI (0x02): Expose based on a manually specified window.
2. ROIAutoExpResultCU84 struct holds the current mode, the X/Y position mapped to 0–255, and the window size.
In manual mode the SDK maps the X/Y coordinates from the video resolution to the 0–255 range.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current ROI auto-exposure mode, position, and window size.
setAPIHeading: bool setAutoExpROIMode(ROIAutoExpModeCU84 roimode, uint32_t vidW, uint32_t vidH, uint32_t xCord, uint32_t yCord, uint8_t wnsize)
setAPIDes: This function sets the ROI auto-exposure mode along with the video dimensions, coordinates, and window size.

tooltip: Exposure Compensation – Sets the exposure compensation value in microseconds
content1: Adjusts the exposure compensation value of the camera to make the image brighter or darker. The value is entered in microseconds (us) and applied with the Set button. Valid range: 50 to 1000000.
content2:
GET_EXPOSURE_COMPENSATION_CU84 (0x11), SET_EXPOSURE_COMPENSATION_CU84 (0x12).
The value is sent as a 32-bit value (MSB first). The SDK rejects values outside EXPOSURE_COMP_MIN_CU84 (50) to EXPOSURE_COMP_MAX_CU84 (1000000).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current exposure compensation value of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the exposure compensation value (range: 50–1000000).

tooltip: Frame Rate Control – Sets the camera frame rate
content1: Sets the output frame rate of the camera. The UI slider ranges from 1 to 120; the camera reports its supported minimum and maximum frame rate.
content2:
GET_FRAME_RATE_CTRL_CU84 (0x13), SET_FRAME_RATE_CTRL_CU84 (0x14).
FrameRateResultCU84 struct holds the current frame rate control value and the minimum and maximum supported frame rates.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current frame rate and the supported minimum and maximum frame rates.
setAPIDes: This function sets the frame rate of the camera.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Configures automatic, 50 Hz, 60 Hz, or disabled flicker suppression
content1: Configures flicker suppression to counter artificial-lighting flicker: Off (disabled), Auto detection, or Manual selection of 50 Hz / 60 Hz mains frequency.
content2:
GET_ANTI_FLICKER_MODE_CU84 (0x17), SET_ANTI_FLICKER_MODE_CU84 (0x18).
AntiFlickerCU84 Enum specifies the anti-flicker mode:
  1. MODE_AUTO (0x00): Auto-detect.
  2. MODE_50Hz (0x01): 50 Hz suppression (Manual).
  3. MODE_60Hz (0x02): 60 Hz suppression (Manual).
  4. MODE_DISABLE (0x03): Anti-flicker disabled (Off).
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current anti-flicker mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the anti-flicker mode of the camera.

tooltip: Stream Mode – Selects Master (free-running) or Trigger streaming
content1: Selects how the camera streams frames: Master mode streams continuously (free-running), while Trigger mode outputs frames on an external trigger.
content2:
GET_STREAM_MODE_CU84 (0x1F), SET_STREAM_MODE_CU84 (0x20).
StreamModeCU84 Enum specifies the stream mode:
  1. MASTER_MODE (0x00): Free-running (master) mode.
  2. TRIGGER_MODE (0x01): External trigger mode.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current stream mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the stream mode of the camera.

tooltip: Flash Mode – Enables or disables the strobe flash output
content1: Enables (Strobe ON) or disables (Strobe OFF) the camera's strobe flash output.
content2:
GET_FLASH_MODE_CU84 (0x21), SET_FLASH_MODE_CU84 (0x22).
FlashModeCU84 Enum specifies the flash mode:
  1. STROBE_OFF (0x00): Flash disabled.
  2. STROBE_ON (0x01): Strobe flash enabled.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current flash mode of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the flash mode of the camera.

tooltip: Q-Factor – Adjusts the JPEG compression quality factor
content1: Controls the JPEG quality factor used for encoding. Higher values give better image quality with less compression. The UI slider ranges from 10 to 96.
content2:
GET_Q_FACTOR_CU84 (0x25), SET_Q_FACTOR_CU84 (0x26).
The Q-factor is passed directly as a uint8_t value.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current Q-factor of the camera.
setAPIDes: This function sets the JPEG Q-factor of the camera.

tooltip: Face Detection – Enables or disables face detection with optional data embedding and overlay
content1: Enables or disables face detection on the camera stream. When enabled, options are available to embed detection data into the stream (Embedded Data) and to overlay a rectangle on detected faces (Overlay rectangle).
content2:
GET_FACE_DETECTION_CU84 (0x23), SET_FACE_DETECTION_CU84 (0x24).
Each flag is sent as 0x01 (enable) or 0x00 (disable).
FaceDetectResultCU84 struct holds the current face detection state:
  1. option: Face detection enable option.
  2. overlayrect: Overlay rectangle enable flag.
  3. embedData: Embed data enable flag.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current face detection option, overlay rectangle state, and embed data state.
setAPIHeading: bool setFaceDetection(bool enableRect, bool overlayrect, bool embedData)
setAPIDes: This function enables or disables face detection and configures the overlay rectangle and embed data options.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the 64-bit unique ID of the camera
content1: Reads the unique 64-bit serial number (unique ID) of the camera device. This is a read-only property used for device identification.
content2: Read through the standard camera HID information (no See3CAM_CU84 extension command). getCameraUniqueID64 retrieves the unique ID as a string. This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses std::string parameter directly (read-only)
bool getCameraUniqueID64(std::string &uniqueID);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the 64-bit unique ID of the camera.
setAPIDes: Serial Number is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Serial Number.
// Use getCameraUniqueID64() to read the device serial number.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the firmware version of the camera
content1: Reads the firmware version from the camera and formats it as Major.Minor1.Minor2.Minor3. This is a read-only property used to identify the firmware running on the device.
content2: Read through the standard camera HID information (no See3CAM_CU84 extension command). readFirmwareVersion retrieves the firmware version as a dot-separated string. This is a read-only operation.
struct1:
// Uses std::string parameter directly (read-only)
bool readFirmwareVersion(std::string &version);
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the firmware version string from the camera.
setAPIDes: Firmware Version is a read-only property. There is no set function available for this control.
setAPICode:
// No set API available for Firmware Version.
// Use readFirmwareVersion() to read the current firmware version.

tooltip: Default – Restores all camera settings to factory defaults
content1: Restores all See3CAM_CU84 camera controls and settings to their factory default values.
getAPIDes: Restore Defaults is a write-only action. There is no get function for this operation.
getAPICode:
// No get API available for Restore Defaults.
// Use restoreDefault() to reset the camera to factory settings.
setAPIDes: This function resets all camera settings to their factory default values.
